import re, zipfile, shutil, os

    shutil.rmtree(workdir)
os.makedirs(workdir)
with zipfile.ZipFile(src) as z:
    z.extractall(workdir)

# map of (sheetfile, cell, cached_value) for formula cells
formula_values = {
    'xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml': {
        'E7': 1, 'F7': 0, 'G7': 0, 'H7': 1,
        'E8': 1, 'F8': 3, 'G8': 2, 'H8': 6,

    'xl/worksheets/sheet2.xml': {
        'C18': 2, 'D18': 18, 'E18': 0,
        'C40': 1, 'D40': 3, 'E40': 2,
    },
}

for fn, cellvals in formula_values.items():
    p = os.path.join(workdir, fn)
    xml = open(p, encoding='utf-8').read()
    for cell, val in cellvals.items():
        # match the cell element and its formula then empty cached value
        pattern = re.compile(r'(<c r="%s"[^>]*>.*?<f[^>]*>.*?</f>)<v></v>(</c>)' % re.escape(cell), re.S)
        newxml, n = pattern.subn(r'\1<v>%s</v>\2' % val, xml)
        if n != 1:
            print('WARN', fn, cell, 'matches', n)
        xml = newxml
    open(p, 'w', encoding='utf-8').write(xml)

# rezip
if os.path.exists(final):
    os.remove(final)
zf = zipfile.ZipFile(final, 'w', zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED)
for root, dirs, files in os.walk(workdir):
    for f in files:
        full = os.path.join(root, f)
        arc = os.path.relpath(full, workdir)
        zf.write(full, arc)
zf.close()
print('final saved', final)
